content.text: Summary: Checked the ledger namespace and found ledger-db-0 is still Running and mounting PVC data-ledger-db-0, which is why the pvc-protection finalizer is (correctly) holding the PVC in Terminating. Confirmed behavior in the Storage Object in Use Protection docs. Resolved T-3006 advising the owner to exclude the in-use PVC from the cleanup script (or scale down ledger-db first with a backup) rather than force-removing the finalizer, which would risk data loss.
